basis: natural valley of the |delta| distribution on scope-aligned probe items
leverage_note: only 2 of 95 scope-aligned items exceed 1%; eps has almost no leverage on real data. That is precisely why P-magnitude exists -- the dense grid manufactures the samples across the tolerance boundary that reality does not provide.
rounding_clause: a narrative figure quoted to fewer digits is SUPPORTED when the filed value falls inside its rounding interval; this branch is parallel to the relative tolerance, not subordinate to it (spec_ambiguities #15)
